description_expanded: Overview5.0(9 reviews)Hot TubGreat Location - 4 Bikes - Recently Renovated- Community Lagoon Pool - Private Beach - 'Coconut Cottage'The SpaceYou will go coconuts over this recently transformed beach vacation home. Nestled conveniently between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach in the idyllic Seacrest Beach neighborhood, Coconut Cottage is a spacious 5-bedroom, 2360 sq ft home perfect for adult groups or families with kids. Cozy up in our open concept living and dining area with ample seating and prepare your favorite meals in our fully stocked kitchen with brand new appliances! Enjoy the fresh breeze on any of the 5 outdoor patio spaces, including a huge courtyard for dining al fresco or lounging. There are a total of 4 king sized beds in the house, plus a bunk room, with 7 smart TVs mounted throughout, and master suites on both the 1st and 2nd level. The 3rd floor lands on a loft space featuring a daybed with a pull-out trundle, bistro set, a wet bar, and a guest suite with another king-sized bed.AREA ATTRACTIONS: Situated in Seacrest Beach Resort, Coconut Cottage is a great spot for days on the beautiful beaches of 30A or at the massive Seacrest Lagoon Pool. Take a bike ride to the neighboring communities of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach or take a stroll to shop or enjoy a meal at one of the many nearby restaurants. It's an easy walk or bike ride to all the locations around Seacrest Beach Community. To make all of that a bit easier on your family, Seacrest Beach boasts a free shuttle/tram service during peak season. We also include 4 bikes for you to use during your stay.Seacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops though out the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: Sleeps 14• 1st floor - Bedroom 1 - King (shared bathroom w/living room)• 2nd floor - Bedroom 2 – Master Suite - King- (private bathroom)• 2nd floor - Bedroom 3 – King (shared bathroom)• 2nd floor - Bunk Room - (New Bunk Space) 2 Twin over Full (shared bathroom)* 3rd floor - Bedroom 4 - King (1/2 bathroom - water closet only)* 3rd floor - Daybed with trundle (shared 1/2 bathroom)HOME HIGHLIGHTS: 4 bikes includedCommunity Pool 12,000 sq ft. (unheated)Master on MainSmart TVsComplimentary WifiGas Grill - Propane includedFully stocked KitchenBiking distance to shops and restaurantsProfessionally Managed, 24/7 ServiceSeacrest Beach Tram is seasonally operated from March through OctoberShow less
